judgments.rationale: Proposal P0000 populates missing core fields (action, action_quote, object, object_quote) for C0001 and properly integrates the governing eligibility criteria from referenced clause (ii) (plans in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007 with a positive funding standard account balance under section 1082(b)). The quotes, logic, modality, and actor are completely faithful to the statutory text.

Proposal P0001 introduces an incorrect factual condition in its summary, stating that the plan was in effect for a plan year beginning in 2008. The source text at clause (ii)(I) explicitly requires the plan to have been in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007.

source_spans.quote: In the case of a single-employer plan described in clause (ii), the plan sponsor may elect to maintain a funding standard carryover balance, until such balance is reduced to zero.

(ii) Plans maintaining funding standard account in 2007 A plan is described in this clause if the plan—

(I) was in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007, and

(II) had a positive balance in the funding standard account under section 1082(b) of this title as in effect for such plan year and determined as of the end of such plan year.
